collection.title: BMW 3 Series Compact 1994 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 3 Series Compact 1994 to 2000 model requires a 20" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this 3 Series Compact which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
